root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `isNumeric()` indexes `chartype_table`, the widened `static_cast<size_t>(in)` value must be proven to fall within the 256-entry lookup-table bound.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original executes `chartype_table[static_cast<size_t>(in)]` with a signed high-bit `char` and never checks whether the widened index stays below `sizeof(chartype_table)`. The fixed original keeps executing the same table lookup site on in-range inputs, but the crashing high-bit path no longer reaches the lookup because the added bound check suppresses it.
root_cause_criterion.evidence: Vulnerable original: the last `numeric_table_lookup` event records `lookup_index=18446744073709551539` and `chartype_table_size=256`. Fixed original: the last `numeric_table_lookup` event records `lookup_index=105` and `chartype_table_size=256` during a clean run.

nodes.state: At the sanitizer sink, the lookup-table read uses an index greater than or equal to `sizeof(chartype_table)`, so the read leaves the 256-entry `chartype_table` object.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `numeric_table_lookup.lookup_index=18446744073709551539` and `numeric_table_lookup.chartype_table_size=256` on the crashing call.

nodes.state: `parseIdentifier()` forwards the first identifier byte unchanged into `isNumeric()` as the callee argument `in`.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `identifier_numeric_probe.first_char_signed == numeric_table_lookup.char_argument_signed == -77` on the crashing call.

edges.relation: `parseIdentifier()` passes the same signed first-byte value as the `in` argument to `isNumeric()`, so the high-bit attacker byte becomes the exact value widened into the out-of-range table index at the sink.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `identifier_numeric_probe.first_char_signed == numeric_table_lookup.char_argument_signed == -77` on the crashing call.
